data.title: 墨染希 · 神社缘侧的月华白襦微露
data.description: 深夜静谧的神社内院，银白月光洒在光洁的木质缘侧上。希仅着一袭纯白的真丝内襦，领口微松，衬托出精致纤细的锁骨与雪肌。晚风卷落庭院中的几片枫叶，少女侧坐在木廊边，玉指轻拢乌黑的长发，眼波流转间满是神明巫女独有的圣洁与深情诱惑。
data.location: tranquil moonlit wooden veranda of traditional shrine overlooking stone garden
data.action: 晚风卷落庭院中的几片枫叶，少女侧坐在木廊边，玉指轻拢乌黑的长发
data.lighting: crystal silver moonlight casting deep gentle shadows on traditional wooden architecture
data.promptProse: Seated gracefully along the polished wooden veranda of the silent hillside shrine at midnight, Nozomi wears only a pure white silk under-kimono whose loosely parted collar reveals her bare shoulders and collarbone. Tucking back a stray lock of her light-brown bob as autumn maple leaves drift past the stone garden, she meets the viewer's gaze with serene, tender allure. Crisp silver moonlight pours over the wooden eaves and illuminates the pale silk folds.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the moonlit wooden shrine veranda in a loosely parted white silk under-kimono, Nozomi brushes back her short hair and smiles serenely with bare shoulders exposed. Silver moonlight washes across the quiet timber eaves and drifting maple leaves.
data.nsfwProse: She wears only a pure white silk under-kimono with wide sleeves and a loosely parted collar slipping low to reveal her bare shoulders and delicate collarbone.
